statistic: absolute difference between genotype and Control mean complex unit phase vectors; timing and concentration jointly
correction: BH FDR across all eight tests
sampling_unit: one earliest eligible sucrose recording per likely animal within genotype and LD/DD condition
limitations: This tests phase-vector organization, not equality of the whole intake or preference profile.
Age and sex distributions are not matched; the comparison is unadjusted for these covariates.
Acrophases from weak cosinor fits can be uncertain.
The sucrose-only LD/DD comparison is a subset of the pooled sucrose/saccharin S1 panels.
Nonsignificance does not establish equivalence or absence of genotype effects.
